types.label: What if
types.description: Changes one condition and asks for reasoned consequences.

types.label: Ethical
types.description: Asks what ought to be done when values conflict.

types.label: Contentious / controversial
types.description: A claim on which informed people genuinely disagree.

types.label: Contemporary
types.description: Connects the topic to a current real-world development.

types.label: Multiple perspectives
types.description: Asks how different stakeholders would judge the same issue.

good_question_criteria: Creates disagreement or multiple defensible views
Requires evidence, data, quotation or subject reasoning
Progresses towards evaluation, justification or design
bad_question_signs: Can be answered by a quick search
Does not require evidence or reasoning
Does not build towards assessment writing
simple_rule: Reject questions that students can answer in less than a minute without using subject knowledge.
